```plato

    //==
    // # RegularPolygon
    //
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Regular_polygon

    // The SideCount vertices on the circumscribed circle, counter-clockwise from
    // Rotation. Named distinctly from `Points` because RegularPolygon does not
    // implement IPointSet2D — its vertices are computed, not stored.
    RegularPolygonVertices(g: RegularPolygon): Array<Point2D>
        => g.SideCount.MapRange(i =>
        {
            var a = g.Rotation + (i.ToNumber / g.SideCount.ToNumber).Turns;
            return g.Center + Vector2D(a.Cos, a.Sin) * g.CircumRadius;
        });
```
